responsibility: Defines the <stdint.h> type-model macros for systems using glibc, uClibc-derived interfaces, or compatible setups, with musl-aware adjustments where required. It chooses exact-width, least-width, fast-width, pointer-sized, and sig_atomic_t type spellings based on LONG_TYPE_SIZE and OPTION_MUSL, making it the shared libc-oriented stdint configuration header for many Linux/GNU targets.
